turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so who decided that, and when?
"Heard my points." That isn't an answer, Hale. Who entered the zero, and on what date?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
"With respect." I'm asking for facts, Hale, and so far you haven't given me one. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.

My son doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat. I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," Hale, with no document on the table. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done here.
